form.title: NEW VEHICLE RECORD
form.subtitle: Create service record
form.validationHint: At least one vehicle must be selected. Enter at least one identifier for each selected vehicle.

records.title: SEARCH OLD RECORD
records.subtitle: Find an old record by plate or customer information.
records.searchPlaceholder: Plate, customer, chassis or fleet no...
records.narrowHint: Select a filter to narrow the search.

selection.connectConnector: Connect the {{pins}}-pin connector from the tractor to the device

measurement.note: Each pin is measured separately. Signal lines are evaluated using PULSE and voltage together.

validation.pin10Body: Confirm whether the lining-wear warning function exists in this vehicle / trailer system. Do not start this test if the function is not present. If it is present, confirm and continue.
validation.pin10Check: The vehicle has a lining-wear function.
validation.pin11Body: Confirm that the relevant brake-system function is actually used in this vehicle / trailer system. Do not start this test if the function is not present. If it is present, confirm and continue.
validation.pin11Check: The vehicle has the relevant brake-system function.
validation.pin12Body: Confirm that the vehicle / trailer has an axle-lift function. Verify that air pressure is suitable and active. Do not start the operation if the pneumatic system or working conditions are unsuitable.
validation.pin12Warning: Do not operate if air pressure is not suitable.
validation.pin12Check: The axle-lift function is present and air pressure is suitable.
validation.genericWarning: Measurement must not start before the function is confirmed.
validation.footer: When CONFIRM AND START is selected, the relevant pin toggle is enabled automatically and measurement starts. If FUNCTION NOT PRESENT is selected, the row remains disabled and is excluded from the report.

cable.chooseStandard: Select the cable standard to test.
cable.connectBothEnds: Connect both ends of the cable to the indicated device sockets.

termination.title: CAN BUS TERMINATION
termination.connectTarget: Connect the {{side}} ISO {{iso}} line to device
termination.deenergizeWarning: Termination resistance may only be measured with the system de-energized. Confirm that external power is off.
termination.confirmDeenergized: I confirm that the system is de-energized and the ignition is off.

lamp.title: LAMP TEST
lamp.connectTrailer: Connect the trailer ISO 12098 connector to device
lamp.oneAtATime: Loads are driven one at a time; activating a new line turns the previous line off.

axle.title: AXLE LIFT SAFETY CONFIRMATION
axle.body: Axle lift uses a controlled 24V load output. The vehicle/trailer must be in a safe position and the pneumatic system must be ready for operation.
axle.warning: Do not start if air pressure is unsuitable or the vehicle is not safe.
axle.confirmation: The vehicle/trailer is safe, axle lift is present and air pressure is suitable.
